This is the single largest driver by a considerable margin. Second, the pleasant temperature of about 26 °C (normalised 0.64) adds a clear positive boost (rank 2, +0.25), as this sits comfortably in the ideal cycling range. Third, being in 2012 (yr=1) contributes another meaningful positive influence (rank 3, +0.21), reflecting the higher overall system demand in that year. Humidity at 78 percent applies a modest damping effect (rank 4, −0.06), while Saturday (weekday=6) nudges demand slightly upward (+0.02, rank 5). August as a month has a very small negative pull (−0.01, rank 6), which is negligible in practice.</drivers>

<recommendation>With an evening peak on a warm Saturday in August, bike availability at popular leisure and commuter stations should be maximised heading into the 19:00 hour. Given the slight but consistent underestimation at these high-demand moments, operations staff should consider keeping a buffer of extra bikes at busy docking stations and planning any redistribution or maintenance tasks for late night hours when demand drops sharply.</recommendation>
